faqs.q: Can Myntmore help Mumbai pharma companies find international export buyers and distributors?
faqs.a: Yes. We have booked verified sourcing, licensing, and distributor meetings in the US, France, UK, UAE, and Singapore for pharmaceutical manufacturers, API suppliers, and packaging firms.

faqs.q: How do you write outreach that sounds credible to pharma sourcing and regulatory heads?
faqs.a: We work directly from your product list, dosage capabilities, regulatory certifications, and commercial differentiators. Every email and LinkedIn sequence is reviewed and approved by your BD team before sending.

faqs.q: Do you work with pharma packaging, excipients, and CRO companies in Mumbai too?
faqs.a: Yes. Beyond APIs and formulations, we have run successful outbound programs for pharma packaging suppliers, clinical research firms, and healthcare service providers.

faqs.q: Can you support our BD team around CPHI or Arab Health?
faqs.a: Yes. We frequently run pre-event outbound campaigns 4 to 6 weeks ahead of major pharma exhibitions so your team arrives with a calendar full of pre-booked booth and hotel meetings.

faqs.q: Are your outbound emails compliant with GDPR and international regulations?
faqs.a: Yes. We structure B2B legitimate-interest outreach carefully, honor every opt-out immediately, and use clean dedicated sending infrastructure to protect deliverability across EU and US mailboxes.
